purpose: Clear blue sky over the bay, with sparse soft clouds and shared HDR radiance in sky, water and PBR reflections. Lighting reference, not a photograph of Shenzhen.

runtime.radiance: Linear HDR with a solar-only luminance shoulder above 8 (asymptote 32) and restrained warm solar tint before spherical harmonics and roughness filtering. Ordinary sky/cloud radiance is unchanged. The sharp sky and PBR reflections share the same graded cube; the source file is untouched.
runtime.solarDirection: Sampled source solar-disc direction in Babylon cube space, transformed by inverse environment rotation. Not astronomical simulation.
runtime.controls: cinematic.setMode('day'); setNight(true/false) remains compatible for night/sunset.

solarHighlight.stage: decode before SH and roughness filtering
